title: Unified Hit Resolution
why: Combat effects are scattered across damage entry points and callers, causing missing rewards, silent destruction, inconsistent knockback, and fragile new attacks.
outcomes: One validated hit contract; target-owned reactions; exactly-once destruction payloads; behavior-preserving migration with regression coverage.

milestones.name: Behavior Inventory
milestones.objective: Capture current production behavior for every damaging or impact path before changing routing.
milestones.success: Every listed path has file/call-site evidence and a keep, fix, or undefined decision; no theoretical matrix is invented.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[Current combat paths] --> B[Inventory damage and impact owners]
  B --> C{Behavior correct?}
  C -->|yes| D[Mark keep]
  C -->|confirmed bug| E[Mark fix]
  C -->|no evidence| F[Mark undefined]
  D --> G[Migration baseline]
  E --> G
  F --> G

tasks.name: Record behavior baseline
tasks.what: Add characterization tests for current damage, reward, knockback, destruction and carrier-impact behavior across the approved 14-path inventory.
tasks.why: Freezes working behavior so migration can distinguish intended fixes from regressions.
acceptance: Covers all 14 provenance paths that exist in production; nonexistent combinations are explicitly marked undefined rather than tested as requirements.
Marks each observed behavior keep, fix or undefined with source call-site evidence.
Records current zero-damage reward scaling without changing it.

milestones.name: Hit Contract
milestones.objective: Introduce explicit enums, context/result schemas, target hooks and a resolver boundary without changing gameplay behavior.
milestones.success: All combat callers can construct one validated HitContext and receive one HitResult; existing paths still pass through adapters.
milestones.diagram:
classDiagram
  class HitContext {
    source
    target
    attackTeam
    targetTeam
    targetClass
    provenance
    damage
    reaction
    impactPosition
    direction
    motion
  }
  class HitResult {
    accepted
    reason
    resourceLoss
    appliedKnockback
    stun
    protectionGained
    feedback
    rewards
    destroyed
  }
  class Target {
    onHit(context,result)
    onDestroyed(context,result)
  }
  class HitResolver {
    resolve(context) HitResult
  }
  HitResolver --> HitContext : validates
  HitResolver --> HitResult : produces
  Target <.. HitResolver : invokes once

tasks.name: Add targeting declarations
tasks.what: Create shared Team, TargetClass and AttackProvenance enums plus affiliation/class accessors in js/combat/targeting.js.
tasks.why: Gives every hit path one validated vocabulary instead of layer/method heuristics.
acceptance: Preserves the confirmed 3x3 team matrix, including neutral to neutral and self exclusion.
Classifies hero, enemy, boss and generic GameObj/destructible targets explicitly.
Rejects unknown teams/classes/provenance before mutation.

tasks.name: Implement hit resolver and target hooks
tasks.what: Add applyHit() with HitContext/HitResult schemas and exactly-once onHit/onDestroyed orchestration in js/combat/damage.js.
tasks.why: Makes one entry point own eligibility, resource changes, reactions, rewards and destruction payload dispatch.
acceptance: Hero shield/energy, enemy/boss death pipelines and GameObj HP/latch semantics remain intact.
Rejected hits produce no damage, feedback, knockback, rewards or callbacks.
onHit runs once per accepted hit, including lethal hits; onDestroyed runs once after onHit.
Chain reactions cannot trigger the same target's destruction payload twice.
Zero-damage accepted hits preserve current actual-damage reward scaling.

milestones.name: Combat Path Migration
milestones.objective: Migrate every existing damaging or impact path to applyHit() while preserving current behavior except confirmed fixes.
milestones.success: No production combat path mutates HP, grants protection, spawns destruction payloads or rewards through a separate routing decision.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[Melee and hitboxes] --> R[applyHit]
  B[Projectiles and object impacts] --> R
  C[Explosions and shockwaves] --> R
  D[Fire dust spike zones] --> R
  E[Carrier macros] --> R
  R --> T{Target lifecycle}
  T --> H[Hero reaction]
  T --> E2[Enemy death pipeline]
  T --> D2[Destructible payload once]

tasks.name: Migrate direct hitbox and projectile paths
tasks.what: Route hero/enemy melee, special melee, super move, projectile and object-impact paths through applyHit() with explicit provenance and reaction settings.
tasks.why: Fixes missing supercoin rewards and centralizes contact/damage decisions for the most common paths.
acceptance: Melee, special melee and super move trigger configured supercoin per-hit rewards.
Projectile top and side object impacts remain behaviorally identical except confirmed reward/destruction fixes.
Existing knockback values, resistance and lethal-hit motion are preserved.
Carrier impact behavior remains owned by its macro/primitive; resolver does not impose a fixed contact enum.

tasks.name: Migrate zone and area attacks
tasks.what: Route fire, dust, spike, beam, shockwave, stomp and dash damage through applyHit(), with dust restricted to living targets and fire allowed to damage destructibles.
tasks.why: Prevents silent destruction and applies exactly-once payloads for area/hazard kills.
acceptance: Dust does not damage or destroy destructibles.
Fire can damage destructibles and runs their destruction payload exactly once when lethal.
Spike, beam, shockwave, stomp and dash preserve baseline reactions except inventory-marked fixes.
A propane destructible destroyed by an eligible area attack spawns its molotov payload exactly once.

tasks.name: Migrate explosions and carrier impacts
tasks.what: Route explosion damage and carrier object contact through applyHit(), while carrier macros retain ownership of detonation, child spawning, bounce and delayed impact policies.
tasks.why: Ensures blasts can resolve destructible lifecycles correctly without turning every macro into a fixed contact enum.
acceptance: Explosions preserve radius, self exclusion, team rules and knockback character.
Eligible explosion damage routes destructibles through the proper HP/destruction lifecycle.
Bombs, molotovs, mines and other carriers keep existing contact/delay/bounce behavior.
Destructible payloads triggered by chain reactions run exactly once.

milestones.name: Regression Gate and Cleanup
milestones.objective: Prove the unified resolver preserves baseline behavior and removes duplicated routing/adapters.
milestones.success: Full relevant test suite passes, known field bugs are fixed, and no production path bypasses applyHit() for damage or destruction effects.
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
  A[Run baseline tests] --> B{All expected keep cases pass?}
  B -->|yes| C[Verify confirmed fixes]
  B -->|no| D[Fix migration regression]
  C --> E[Remove obsolete adapters]
  E --> F[Update docs and plan status]

tasks.name: Verify unified hit behavior matrix
tasks.what: Add production-path regression tests for the approved inventory cases, team matrix, target hooks and exactly-once destruction.
tasks.why: Turns today's field bugs and preserved baseline behaviors into enforceable gates.
acceptance: Melee on supercoin yields configured per-hit coins.
Dust does not affect destructibles while fire still can.
Propane destroyed by any eligible attack spawns molotovs exactly once.
No duplicate flash, knockback, reward or destruction payload occurs under chain reactions.
Invalid context inputs throw before mutation and leave resources unchanged.

tasks.name: Remove obsolete routing adapters
tasks.what: Delete duplicated team predicates, caller-owned barrel aftermath calls and temporary damage adapters once all production paths use applyHit().
tasks.why: Prevents future bypasses and makes the resolver the single source of truth.
acceptance: No production combat path directly chooses takeDamage/hit/damage as a routing policy.
handleBarrelDestroyed or equivalent payload service is invoked only through the resolver/target adapter exactly once.
Existing public APIs required by unmigrated systems are explicitly documented as temporary if any remain.
verify: cd petal-panic && rg -n "takeDamage\(|\.hit\(|damage\(" js/combat js/systems js/objects
